Q5025.reason: A keloid is an overgrowth of granulation tissue forming a firm, raised mass of scar tissue beyond the original wound.

Q5026.reason: Intention tremor worsens with goal-directed movement and indicates cerebellar dysfunction, unlike a Parkinsonian rest tremor.

Q5028.reason: A proposed school-site label on a plat and sales brochure, without a conveyance, accepted dedication, or covenant in a deed, creates no enforceable servitude or public easement.
